summary: Tested Idées cadeaux (packs + featured) and Carte cadeau flows end-to-end. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases PASS (public GET /api/gift-ideas, admin auth guard, admin GET packs, full pack CRUD with public visibility check, and settings PUT /api/settings for gift_intro/giftcard_amounts/giftcard_terms with public reflect). Frontend: Admin /admin -> onglet Cadeaux -> gift-intro edit + featured products via ComplementarySelector saves with 'Enregistré' toast; pack-new modal creates a coffret (name, desc, product, price=4500) - appears in packs-list with pack-edit/pack-del; public /idees-cadeaux shows gift-intro, gift-packs and gift-featured; clicking gift-pack-add creates exactly ONE cart line at pack price (4 500 DA, cart_items=1 confirmed); admin giftcard config (amount edit, terms edit) persists and public /carte-cadeau shows updated amounts (giftcard-amount-1500) + terms; giftcard-order-btn adds 'Carte cadeau Pharma360' line and navigates to /commande; when giftcard_enabled=false, /carte-cadeau shows giftcard-disabled. Test data cleaned up (pack deleted, settings restored to defaults).

issues: Cart page body content appeared largely empty on screenshot even though cart-item-* rendered (cart_items=1) and header badge shows correct 4 500 DA. Possibly a lazy render or layout issue worth a visual check by main agent, but not blocking - price/quantity/testid all correct.

critical_code_review_comments: GiftPackModal save button (pack-save) requires scroll_into_view to be reliably clickable in a 1080 viewport - modal content may extend beyond viewport when multiple products are chosen. Consider making the modal body scrollable while keeping the save button in a sticky footer inside the modal.

SettingsContext appears to cache values across SPA navigations. When updating giftcard fields the first time in a session, a soft-navigate to /carte-cadeau may show stale data unless a hard reload / refresh() is triggered. Verified refresh works after 'gifts-save' triggers refresh() internally, but timing between save and navigate should be increased or SettingsContext should re-fetch on route entry.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: created TEST_Coffret E2E pack and temporarily changed gift_intro / giftcard_amounts[0]=1500 / giftcard_terms. All cleaned up at end of run - pack deleted, settings restored to production defaults, gift_featured_ids reset to [].
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login route is /compte (data-testid=login-identifier, login-password, auth-submit). Admin uses tab data-testid=admin-tab-gifts. ComplementarySelector search input is data-testid=pf-comp-search (present multiple times when a modal is open - use .last for modal, .first for the panel). Pack save button (pack-save) inside modal may be below the fold - use scroll_into_view_if_needed before click. Cleanup was done at end; no leftover test data in DB.
rca of the issue: No blocking bugs. Minor code-review nits documented above.
